Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood case study opportunity — interest and logistics

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the rollout options. Our marketing team is interested in doing a joint case study focusing on cost savings and uptime improvements after moving inference to Redwood Dedicated.

We can commit to a ~45 minute discovery call to capture outcomes, stakeholders, and a couple of quotes. Would the week of Nov 29 work for you? We prefer mornings (PST).

Also: is it okay if we record the call for transcription and to pull verbatim quotes for the case study? We will share the final draft for approval before publishing.

Attaching our logo and a short brand guide.

Thanks,

Avery Collins
Head of Marketing, Meridian Health
avery.collins@meridianhealth.com
(415) 555-0142

Hi Avery — great to hear and thanks for sending the assets. We'd love to do this.

Proposed 45-minute slots (PST) the week of Nov 29:
- Tue 11/30 10:00–10:45
- Wed 12/01 09:00–09:45
- Thu 12/02 11:00–11:45

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & who will be quoted (5 min)
2) Background & business context (10 min)
3) Implementation timeline & technical highlights (10 min)
4) Results: latency, throughput, cost deltas (10 min)
5) Approvals & next steps (10 min)

Recording: yes — we record for notes and transcription. We'll only use verbatim quotes with your approval during the review. If you prefer not to record, we can take notes instead. Please confirm recording consent on the call or reply here.

Internal participants joining from Redwood: Rishi (Engineering lead, deployment details) and Neha (Customer Success, outcomes/metrics).

If any other Meridian stakeholders should join (security, procurement), please add them and we will update the agenda. Once you pick a slot I'll send a calendar invite and a short prep doc.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: Case Study Prep for Meridian Health — Calendar + Recording Permission

Team — forwarding Meridian's note and our proposed agenda/slots. Quick asks before I confirm a time: 
- Rishi: can you be prepared to talk through the Dedicated capacity sizing, autoscaling behavior we configured, and the mitigation we used to reduce token costs? 10 minutes max.
- Neha: can you bring the post-migration KPIs (p50/p95 latency, monthly inference spend delta, uptime) and a one-sentence outcome quote we can attribute to product/ops.

If you need any slides, I can draft 1–2 visuals (latency chart + cost breakdown). Meridian will likely want a short (45 min) call, so keep slides minimal.

I'll wait for Meridian to pick a slot then send an invite with recording enabled and the prep doc link.

Thanks — Marissa
